release_semantics: Scene-local periodic source; phase zero on every entry, including consecutive active scenes. Emit every release strictly before scene end. Reject any deadline beyond the scene; never drop a request.

balanced.rationale: Historical equal request shares; resource demand is not equal across networks.

concurrent.rationale: Keep rates and deadlines; introduce four-way concurrency and 750 requests. Concurrency and total demand change together, so this is a workload-class comparison.

asymmetric.rationale: Half-rate large detectors, original tiny rates; deadlines remain 40 ms to isolate rate changes. 376 explicitly generated requests, not deletion from an old stream.

preheat.method: Reuse archived original-evaluator final state; no new heat simulation or tuning.
preheat.accounting: Exogenous common inlet. Preheat energy reported separately and excluded from the 10.04 s objective. Deployment ready at evaluation start; migration/loading costs outside current model.

domain.policy: Exactly the 81 concrete stored bindings in search_order. No runtime DLA symmetry reduction; warm inlet is asymmetric. Not the entire general legal deployment space.

future_diagnostic.case_order: load declaration order, then order declaration order, then reference_start/preheated
future_diagnostic.method: Adapted existing exact method, no new heuristic; algorithm selection not frozen.
future_diagnostic.on_timeout: retain best SAFE witness, valid bound, completed coverage, and UNRESOLVED; no budget extension

future_model_boundary.per_network_deadlines: Schema supports positive deadlines <= period with every due time inside its scene. Heterogeneous deadlines are not exercised by these 12 cases.
future_model_boundary.other_networks: ResNet-18 and MobileNetV2 are source-review candidates only, not admitted performance models.
future_model_boundary.scene_carryover: No unfinished requests at a feasible scene boundary. Carryover work would require a separate model revision.
